text:
Ana Rivera: quick sync idea: follow-up to the telemetry pipeline RFC. propose an edge 'slimbridge' that strips high-cardinality attrs to reduce ingest cost but preserves a stable billing_key + provenance pointer for later reconciliation.
CJ Park: short answer: doable. main needs: explicit canonical keys and a deterministic billing_key derivation at the edge so billing doesn't rely on sidecars.
Michael Li: +1 but two tradeoffs: 1) late-join correctness if attrs are thrown away, 2) lower debuggability in early hops.
Ana Rivera: sketch: envelope emitted from edge -> {billing_key, tenant_id, provenance, compact_flags, minimal_span_meta, attr_ref?}. full attrs POSTed to sidecar store for 48h when route is billing-sensitive.
Sara Gupta: how does this interact with sampling? if sampling happens after the bridge we lose attribution for unsampled traces.
CJ Park: either sample at edge (if we prune attrs) or emit a lightweight attr_ref header (trace_id + short ref) so enrichment can fetch full attrs for late samples.
Ana Rivera: attr_ref pattern: set header x-attr-ref: sha256(trace_id + ts) and store mapping in enrichment-cache for TTL 48h.
Michael Li: implementation risk: cache key explosion. mitigate with TTL + LRU and only create refs for traces that match billing predicate (route/model tag).
Sara Gupta: for multi-model routing billing, billing_key must be stable and derivable from minimal meta. avoid opaque runtime-only pointers for billing.
CJ Park: agreed. rule: billing_key = tenant_billing_id if present else sha256(tenant_id + '|' + route). compute at edge before attr pruning.
Ana Rivera: small pseudocode for edge agent to copy:
```
if has(tenant_billing_id): billing_key = tenant_billing_id
else: billing_key = sha256(tenant_id + '|' + route)
if sensitive_attrs.present and route in billing_sensitive_routes:
  attr_ref = sha256(trace_id + now())
  enrichment_cache.put(attr_ref, full_attrs, ttl=48h)
  emit_envelope(billing_key, attr_ref, minimal_meta)
else:
  emit_envelope(billing_key, null, minimal_meta)
```
CJ Park: ops/security: stored full_attrs need KMS-wrapped encryption + RBAC. enrichment workers must fetch via service account.
Sara Gupta: fallback when enrichment-cache is down: either emit envelope with full_attrs (costly) or mark trace as degraded and route to safe fallback model.
Michael Li: can we reuse existing enrichment-cache service instead of standing up a new store? reduces ops burden.
Ana Rivera: reuse is preferred. CJ, can you model expected hot storage? rough calc: 1KB avg attrs * 1M traces/day * 10% flagged => ~100GB/day -> 48h ~200GB hot.
CJ Park: I'll run numbers and add a spreadsheet. also add per-route feature toggle for rollout/abort.
Sara Gupta: rollout plan: canary 1% traffic on low-risk routes 24h. monitor billing delta, "attr-missing" errors, and queryability regressions.
ingest-bot: Note: created deploy checklist item #3124 for "edge-slimbridge-gate" (assignee: CJ Park). :robot_face:
Ana Rivera: action items: CJ -> capacity numbers + config-toggle PR; Michael -> spike cache integration; Sara -> SLO definitions + canary checklist; me -> update RFC with pseudocode. target ship under feature-flag in 2 sprints.
CJ Park: ack. will post spreadsheet and perf estimates by EOD tomorrow.
Michael Li: spiking cache reuse tomorrow, will post short notes.
Sara Gupta: drafting canary SLIs now and will attach to checklist.
Ana Rivera: thanks all. fallback posture: if we hit weirdness revert to emitting full_attrs until fixed. :thumbsup:
